<!-- [Input] Unique src, immutable recovered dependencies and checked source/qualification authority. -->
<!-- [Output] Own static CI, four-host qualification and exact-artifact npm publishing. -->
<!-- [Pos] GitHub configuration folder. -->
<!-- [Sync] 2026-09-13: docs/publisher-only edits use ordinary CI; preserve native qualification and immutable publishing. -->

# .github

workflows/ owns source/static CI and the qualification → publishing chain.
Recovered dependency/platform assets and official fixtures are immutable external inputs,
not a second implementation. Only src is compiled. Publishing consumes the successful
same-repository/current-main qualification's exact five tarballs, never rebuilds them.
npm environment authentication is reused without exposing credentials.
Documentation/folder/publisher-only changes do not regenerate same-version Runtime
artifacts; ordinary CI still validates source inventory and offline publisher regressions.
